atoms.text: Jean-Pierre went on a bike ride with his friends. This distance-time graph shows how long it took him to cycle 100 kilometres.

instruction.text: Fill out the table using the graph.

trainers.hint: You can find the distance cycled in kilometres for a given time by finding the time on the bottom axis, going up to the plotted point for that time, then going across from the point to the side axis.

instruction.text: Are these statements about the graph true? Select the correct answer.

atoms.a: The entire bike ride took 8 hours.
Jean-Pierre travelled 20 kilometres during the first hour of the cycle.
Jean-Pierre did not move at all between hours 3 and 5.
Jean-Pierre was faster between hours 2 and 3 than he was between hours 3 and 4.

atoms.text: Jolene loves building and flying paper aeroplanes. This distance-time graph shows how far and for how long her last paper aeroplane flew.
